editorial_source: Garlén, C. (1988). Svenskans fonologi. Studentlitteratur. Plus Lgr22 svenska årskurs 1–3 (Skolverket) — grundläggande läs- och skrivinlärning + ljudning. The sj-cluster + tj/kj allophone inventory is the canonical Swedish K-1 chunk set.
policy_note: Swedish sj-ljudet has multiple spellings (sj, skj, stj, sch, sk(i/e/y/ä/ö)) all mapping to the same /ɧ/ phoneme; tj-ljudet has tj, kj, k(i/e/y/ä/ö); ng-ljudet is its own phoneme. These chunks are treated as single sounds in K-1 ljudmetoden phonics. The å/ä/ö letters are separate letters in Swedish (not modified vowels of a/o), so they are single-letter chunks in their own right.

context_sensitive_chunks.comment: These letter sequences ALSO map to sj/tj sounds when followed by specific front vowels (i, e, y, ä, ö). Pipeline gate may approve these via NST phoneme verification — they aren't fixed orthographic chunks.
